The StructureDefinitions were later removed from core when globally defined extensions moved to the Extension Pack.
additional_context: Current core only retains canonical OID assignments and a clinical reasoning extension-table row that says cqf-relativeDateTime is deprecated and links to relative-date, with a page caveat that the Extension Pack is source of truth. The Extension Pack has relative-date active and cqf-relativeDateTime retired/deprecated. Later decisions FHIR-39327, FHIR-34232, FHIR-41598, FHIR-50027, and FHIR-53078 explain current differences from the literal 2021 resolution.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was needed because the seed change was already applied and the authoritative current extension content is outside the core checkout.
